purpose: Durable per-family resume state for the 253-family modern-rescue programme; records git-derived COVERAGE facts only (whether source/tests/skin CSS were touched since the pre-programme baseline) -- it makes NO quality claim and certifies nothing.

stateVocabulary.UNTOUCHED: No commit since the baseline touched any file under sourceOwner. Does NOT mean the family is unstyled or non-compliant today -- it may have been fine before the programme started, or it may need work nobody has reached yet.
stateVocabulary.SOURCE_TOUCHED: At least one commit since the baseline touched a non-tests file under sourceOwner. Does NOT mean the family is DONE, elevated, reviewed, or Quiet-Premium-compliant -- only that its source was edited. Verdict lives in reviewVerdict, which this file does not set.
stateVocabulary.TESTS_ONLY: Commits since the baseline touched only files under sourceOwner's tests/ folder, never the source itself. Does NOT mean the family was reviewed or is covered -- only that its own implementation files were not edited.

fieldNotes.sourceCommits: Count of commits since baselineCommit that touched ANY file (source or tests) under sourceOwner.
fieldNotes.lastCommit/lastCommitDate: Short SHA and date of the most recent such commit, or null if sourceCommits is 0.
fieldNotes.skinFiles: Re-derived 2026-08-10 (WO-CRA-23 skin-ownership pass) from SCOPE-CLASS EVIDENCE, not name matching. Method: (1) parsed every selector in all skin-bearing CSS files across THREE locations -- runtime/engines/modern/skin/ (123 files), presentation/components/skin/ (146 files), and a third, smaller, mostly-token location, presentation/components/*.css directly (10 of its 32 files carry real selectors rather than only :root custom properties: arc.css, card.css, feature-pictogram.css, icon-frame.css, mark.css, meter.css, patterns.css, patterns-paint.css, semantic-icon.css, semantic-surface.css -- the last two plus mark.css/feature-pictogram.css belong to graphics/ system assets outside this family ledger and patterns-paint.css is a confirmed-dead tombstone, so none of those four are attributed to any row); extracted the LEFTMOST compound of every top-level selector as that file's owned scope-class set, excluding the three layer-marker classes ds-structure/ds-surface/ds-engine-modern, which recur across every family in their layer and identify NOTHING on their own. (2) For each family, recursively scanned its sourceOwner directory (which already contains any nested engines/modern/index.tsx) for every literal ds-*/rottay-* token, EXCLUDING the subtree of any OTHER row whose own sourceOwner nests inside it (prevents a parent directory from absorbing a sibling family's evidence -- see prunedChildren case notes below). For rows whose recorded sourceOwner is itself a shared parent/grandparent directory because the kebab-cased family name did not match the real component folder (bullet/gauge/sankey/scatter/waterfall charts under charts/, PatternDataTable/GridView/StatsGrid/FormBuilder/CalendarView/MapView/Timeline/KanbanBoard/LocaleSwitcher/BrandStudio/PageShell, DetailHeader/EditHeader, ResponsiveSlot, and the 4 rows that shared surfaces/composition/layout/ before the 2026-08-12 individual split), evidence was instead read from the verified real component subdirectory -- sourceOwner itself was left untouched; the corrected path and reason are on each affected row only as an implicit fact captured in this note, not as a new field. (3) Matched family evidence classes against each file's owned scope-class set: a family owns a file when they intersect on a SPECIFIC (non-layer-marker) class. A few files carry zero live selectors (profile.css, adaptive-overlay.css, input-residual.css) or keyframe-only bodies my selector parser does not walk (data-terminal-card-keyframes.css, stats-header-keyframes.css, toast-animation-keyframes.css, primitive-motion.css) -- those were attributed by reading the file's own header comment plus a corroborating grep hit (literal class/keyframe-name string, or a contract test) inside the claimed family's own directory. chart-foundation.css (shared scaffold/frame/tooltip/renderer paint) and surface-section-card.css (the surfaces/runtime/helpers/rendering section-card helper) are emitted by shared infrastructure that sits OUTSIDE any single family's sourceOwner, so ownership there was established by grepping which families' own directories import that shared infrastructure, then recorded as shared across all of them. The 11 former commercial-layer families shipped co-located ComponentName.css files next to their index.tsx (rt- class prefix) -- a fourth location entirely, outside both named skin trees. The 2026-08-12 taxonomy adjudication dissolved that layer: nine survivors moved into canonical owners and their CSS drained into presentation/components/skin/, so no row uses the fourth location any more; ProductWindow left for the Showroom and TreeView merged into the canonical tree family. An empty array now appears ONLY on rows with a sibling `skinEvidence` field stating the positive evidence that no skin file exists (6 rows: Show, Hide, ResponsiveSlot, ResizeHandle, ConnectedCommandPalette, PageShellSurface -- TableCheckboxStyles was the seventh until it was retired at source). Shared ownership (a file claimed by >1 family) is enumerated in the new top-level `sharedSkinFiles` map.
fieldNotes.hasFocusedTests: True if <sourceOwner>/tests/ exists on disk and contains at least one *.test.* or *.spec.* file.
fieldNotes.hasProbeScene: True if the family or component name appears as a case slug in one of the 5 sections that use the cases.ts convention (commercial, compositions, r4-structures, r5-charts, r6-surfaces), OR as a literal PascalCase identifier anywhere in the combined source of packages/showroom/src/app/probe/ds-reference/sections/**/*.{ts,tsx}. The other 17 section folders (control, display-*, feedback, field, inputs-material, microbatch-material, overlay*, r2-*, r3-evidence, transient-material) have NO cases.ts -- they compose DS components directly by import, so identifier search is the only detection method for them. False is a real 'not found by this search', not a guess, but can still miss an aliased import (e.g. `import { Button as Btn }`).
fieldNotes.batch/reviewVerdict/openDefects: Reserved for the review/adjudication pass this ledger exists to make resumable. Untouched by this generation; a later pass owns writing to them.
fieldNotes.writeRoot: The exclusive directory a single lane may write for this family, derived from the folder that DECLARES the component and then widened only while no other family declares inside it. It is NOT sourceOwner: that field is a resolution pointer and 18 rows share 5 of its paths (structures/headers is claimed by DetailHeader and EditHeader, patterns/visualization/charts by five chart families), so using it as a write set would have put two concurrent lanes in the same directory. writeExcludes carves out a nested family that legitimately lives inside another - HeaderSurface sits under PageShellSurface.
fieldNotes.elevationCommits: Commits that elevated this family in wave 2. Presence here does NOT set reviewVerdict: no adversarial review has been run on any wave-2 family, which is why each carries the openDefect saying so.

rows.skinEvidence: Renders zero classes of its own -- the `className` prop is passed through verbatim from the caller (index.tsx: 'expansion and paint stay with the owning skin via className'); the test's className="skin-owned" is a caller-supplied probe value, not a real class. Scoping is via data-part='resize-handle' only, which is shared vocabulary, not evidence of a dedicated file.
Same CSS-first inline-<style> architecture as Show (its documented inverse); renders no class of its own. No ds-hide file exists anywhere in the repo.

Composition-only primitive over Show/Hide's inline-<style> mechanism; its own evidence contains no class beyond the generic 'ds-show-' token consumed from Show. No ds-responsive-slot file exists anywhere in the repo.

CSS-first component: renders its OWN inline <style> tag with @media rules at render time (see index.tsx header) -- architecturally self-contained, never reaches a centralized skin file in any of the three trees. No ds-show/rottay-show file exists anywhere in the repo.

Explicitly documented 'minimal surface wrapper around the generic PatternPageShell pattern component' (its own JSDoc); renders zero className -- all chrome paint belongs to PatternPageShell (patterns/shell/page-shell -> page-shell.css), a separate tracked family.

Read in full: pure composition wrapper around PatternCommandPalette + PatternShortcutsOverlay (both separately tracked families) with useEffect/useCallback hooks only -- zero className or data-part usage anywhere in its own file. The earlier 'ds-keyboard-shortcuts' token in evidence was a command-registry id string, not a CSS class (`id: 'ds-keyboard-shortcuts'` at index.tsx:164). Confirms the team lead's hunch.
